title: Continuity of the orthogonal projection onto the range, on injective linear maps
statement: For all n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, the map Π: L(ℝⁿ, ℝ^{n+ℓ}) → L(ℝ^{n+ℓ}, ℝ^{n+ℓ}) sending A to the orthogonal projection onto its range A(ℝⁿ) is continuous, for the operator-norm topologies, on the set of injective A ∈ L(ℝⁿ, ℝ^{n+ℓ}).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), ContinuousOn (fun (A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] Ambient n ℓ) ↦ (LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap).starProjection) {A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] Ambient n ℓ | Function.Injective A}
